question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom / Phrase.

To turn a deaf ear to

options.text: To refuse to listen and consider

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"to turn a deaf ear to"** means to deliberately ignore or refuse to listen to someone or something. (किसी बात को अनसुना करना)

 
 
• **Example:** Despite numerous complaints, the manager **turned a deaf ear to the employees'** grievances.
 
 
 
• **"To refuse to listen and consider"** means to intentionally avoid giving attention or thought to a particular matter. (ध्यान न देना और विचार करने से इंकार करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The council **turned a deaf ear to the residents'** concerns about the new policy.
 
 

Therefore, the correct meaning of the given idiom is** 'this action is open to a number of interpretations.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To have an ear ache** (कान में दर्द होना): Experiencing pain in the ear.

 
 
• **Example:** She couldn't attend the meeting because she **had a severe ear ache.**
 
 
 
• **To get into trouble** (मुसीबत में पड़ना): To encounter problems or difficulties.
 
 
• **Example:** He **got into trouble** for breaking the school rules.
 
 
 
• **To become deaf** (बहरा होना): Losing the ability to hear.
 
 
• **Example:** After the accident, he **became deaf **in one ear.

The correct answer is **Option 2)**
